findingClass: pull-model verification check CORPUS-SHAPE: per source, does the live page behind each fixture still match the fixture’s SHAPE (labels + structure the extractor depends on, never the values)
whatItAsks: per source, does the live page behind each fixture still match the fixture’s SHAPE (labels + structure the extractor depends on, never the values)
healthy: no shape difference from the fixture
alarmsWhen: a label or structure moves — files an issue naming the source, the fixture and the label that moved
scope: phase-1 IPOs, MAINBOARD + SME, prod + staging slots (docs/design/data-sourcing-pull-model.md §2.1)
consumer: nightly floor-delta (Notifier post + issue on NEW)
consumerReason: the design specifies a weekly scheduled job (§4.5); the floor-delta consumer is the only one of the two named consumers that already runs on a schedule independent of the pull cycle, so the weekly run rides that same NEW/GONE/SAME diffing consumer
status: built — wired at scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs (checkS_corpusShape); predicates in scripts/lib/corpus-shape-checks.mjs, self-tested by scripts/tests/corpus-shape-checks.test.mjs
sourceDesign: docs/design/data-sourcing-pull-model.md §4.5 ("How we would know it worked")
note: CORPUS-SHAPE: per source, does the live page behind each HTML fixture still carry the labels its extractor keys on (never the values). Measured 2026-09-22: the corpus holds 11 HTML fixtures and 0 carry a fetchable sourceUrl (all 11 grandfathered in config/fixture-provenance-baseline.json), so this check records UNVERIFIABLE until a fixture is attributed via scripts/create-fixture-from-capture.mjs --source-url — never PASS, because it has measured nothing. Network is opt-in: the nightly floor fetches, CI sets CORPUS_SHAPE_FETCH=0 so the PR gate never depends on a third-party site.
